# Environmental Monitoring Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Life Sciences

## Overview

Use when managing pharmaceutical environmental monitoring programs including cleanroom classification, viable and non-viable particle monitoring, alert/action limit management, and trend analysis for GMP manufacturing areas.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [environmental-monitoring-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
environmental-monitoring-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@environmental-monitoring` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design environmental monitoring programs: locations, frequency, methods, limits
- Monitor viable particle counts: settle plates, active air, surface sampling
- Track non-viable particle counts for ISO classification compliance
- Manage alert and action limit exceedances with investigation workflow

## Industry Standards Applied

- **EU GMP Annex 1 (2022)**: Manufacture of sterile medicinal products environmental requirements
- **ISO 14644-1/2/3**: Cleanroom classification and monitoring standards
- **USP <797>/<800>**: Pharmaceutical compounding environmental monitoring requirements
